# Sarthak Ojha Portfolio

This is the portfolio website of Sarthak Ojha, a Mobile App Developer specializing in iOS, Android, and cross-platform technologies.

## Website Structure

- **Home**: https://sarthakojha.com.np/ - Main portfolio landing page
- **About**: https://sarthakojha.com.np/#about - Information about Sarthak Ojha's background and experience
- **Skills**: https://sarthakojha.com.np/#skills - Technical skills and expertise
- **Projects**: https://sarthakojha.com.np/#projects - Portfolio of mobile and web development projects
- **Contact**: https://sarthakojha.com.np/#contact - Contact information and form

## Developer Profile

Sarthak Ojha is a software developer based in Kathmandu, Nepal with expertise in:
- Mobile App Development (iOS, Android, React Native, Flutter)
- Full-Stack Web Development
- UI/UX Design
- Performance Optimization
